extDescription.message: Reads web pages aloud through the system's Speech Dispatcher: the voice for each language comes from your speech settings.

cmdPick.message: Choose the part of the page to read

pickHelp.message: Click: read this part · Shift+click: read from here · Wheel or ↑↓: larger/smaller · ←→: neighbours · Esc: cancel

popReadTitle.message: The selection, or else the main text found as in Reader View

popPickTitle.message: Choose a part of the page with the mouse or the keyboard

popPageTitle.message: All the visible text, also menus, header and footer

popPin.message: Keep these controls on the page

panelClose.message: Close the panel in this tab

popAllSitesTitle.message: Show the ▶ buttons and the panel on every page without opening this window first. Firefox asks for the right to read all sites; the text still goes only to Speech Dispatcher on this computer.
